meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 仍是总指挥,但多了一组 MCP 工具:能列出本地 Atomic Chat 应用里的模型,并向指定模型发送提示词、取回回答,把部分任务交给本地模型处理。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求用 Atomic Chat 或本地模型处理任务时,Claude 会先列出可用模型,再选择其中一个生成回答。

say.text: 用 Atomic Chat 告诉我法国的首都。
say.note: Claude 会列出模型并调用其中一个生成回答。

say.text: 列出 Atomic Chat 当前有哪些可用模型。

howto.what_en: Claude remains the coordinator but can now call local Atomic Chat models via MCP: list available models, send prompts to one, and get its response, offloading some work.
howto.when_en: When the user explicitly asks to use Atomic Chat or a local model, Claude lists available models first, then picks one to generate an answer.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists models and calls one to generate the answer.

say_en.text: Use the atomic_chat_generate tool with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: what is quantum computing?
say_en.note: Specify tool and model to force the generation flow.

say_en.text: List the models currently available in Atomic Chat.
